exercises.why: **задерживай** — заде́рживать (imperfective): to detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check; to arrest, to detain; to slow down, to retard, to delay, to hamper. Wiktionary: задержа́ть + -ивать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to detain, to hold back, to stop
to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: заде́рживать — to detain, to hold back, to stop; приде́рживать — to hold, to hold back; неудержи́мый — irrepressible; выде́рживать — to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure.

**выдерживаю** — выде́рживать (imperfective): to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure; to pass exam; to contain oneself, to control oneself; to maintain, to keep up, to observe. Wiktionary: вы́держать + -ивать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
